anchors.name: Main Castle Compound
anchors.relation: Centered on north-south main road axis; entrance faces south.

anchors.name: Main Castle Front Stair / Entry
anchors.relation: Must terminate on central north-south road; no lateral drift.

anchors.name: NW Chapel
anchors.relation: Must stay on NW chapel plot, west of N2A.

anchors.name: NW Chapel Prop Cluster
anchors.relation: Props remain immediately east/southeast of chapel; may not migrate into N2A footprint.

anchors.name: North-left House
anchors.relation: Specific plot east of chapel; front edge meets lower local path.

anchors.name: North-right House
anchors.relation: Specific upper-right house plot; must not exchange with N2A or N4C.

anchors.name: North-right Stall / Trellis Cluster
anchors.relation: Immediately west/northwest of N3A, adjacent to local path.

anchors.name: NE Inner Wall Tower / Stair Tower
anchors.relation: Fixed on north-east inner wall access line.

anchors.name: NE Garden Structural Props
anchors.relation: Only non-Ground structures inside NE garden plot; flowers/grass remain Ground.

anchors.name: NE Small Tower House
anchors.relation: Fixed far-right inner plot; must not drift west into garden or road.

anchors.name: North-west Wall Segment
anchors.relation: Continuous wall between NW tower and main-castle west zone.

anchors.name: North-east Wall Segment
anchors.relation: Continuous wall between main-castle east zone and NE tower.
